versions.changelog:
Cattail Mat Weaving Basics 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Guides users in creating durable, insulating mats from local cattail leaves, covering every stage from plant ID to finished, testable products.
- Agent automates species verification, yield/volume math, planning and progress tracking, safety protocols, and barter template generation.
- Human handles all harvesting, sorting, weaving, tightening, and manual testing steps.
- Includes step-by-step 21-day workflow with detailed agent-human task division.
- Features ready-to-use templates for field reports, progress logging, and trade/barter communications.
- Emphasizes hands-on learning and self-reliance; enforces safety and quality control throughout.
